speaker: Doctor
text: The biopsy confirms severe epidermal necrosis, which is highly suggestive of Toxic Epidermal Necrolysis (TEN). Given the mucositis and recent medication changes, this is a medical emergency requiring immediate discontinuation of the offending drug and admission to a burn unit. DIAGNOSIS READY: Toxic Epidermal Necrolysis (TEN)
